caption: The drawing depicts a two-part house on a plain, neutral background. The main section of the house is rectangular and colored red with visible brickwork. It is two stories high and has a large, slate-gray hip roof with a single red brick chimney at the apex. This section features five tall, rectangular windows on the visible sides and a small, arched front doorway with a triangular pediment above it. Attached to the right side of the main structure is a smaller, one-story extension, colored off-white or light gray with darker window outlines, also featuring visible bricks or stonework at the base. This addition has a gabled slate-gray roof with another, shorter chimney. There are four windows and a small porch with steps and railings at the entrance, which has an arched doorway. The drawing is done using watercolor and ink, showing fine details in the textures of the roof, walls, and brickwork. The artist's name "N. A. Sampson" and the year "1937" are signed in the lower-left corner.
title: Toy House
